title.en: The Shelter Band & the River Fog Festival

subtitle.zh: 西南山城 · 防空洞排练室 · 高考后的十三天
subtitle.en: A foggy mountain river city, a rehearsal room in an old air-raid shelter, thirteen days after the exams

premise.zh:
第一人称「我」十八岁，刚考完高考，暑假被爸妈送到西南山城雾江市的舅舅家住。舅舅在半山腰开了一家小 Livehouse「坡上」，门口贴着一张手写的「贝斯手急招」。
雾江市在两条江交汇的山上，楼比路高，轻轨从居民楼中间穿过去，出门就是几百级梯坎。半山有一个废弃的防空洞，被一支叫「七号防空洞」的地下乐队租来当排练室。
十三天后，江边的「江雾音乐节」开幕，新人舞台只有一个名额。「我」会弹一点贝斯，于是被拽了进去。
premise.en:
The first-person narrator ("I") is eighteen and has just sat the college entrance exam. For the summer my parents have packed me off to my uncle's place in Wujiang, a foggy mountain city in the southwest. Halfway up the hill my uncle runs a tiny live-music bar called Slope, and taped to its door is a handwritten sign: BASSIST WANTED, URGENT.
Wujiang sits on a hill where two rivers meet. The buildings are taller than the streets, the light rail runs straight through an apartment block, and every errand means a few hundred stone steps. Halfway up the hill an old air-raid shelter has been rented out as a rehearsal room by an underground band called Shelter No. 7.
In thirteen days the River Fog Festival opens on the riverbank, and the newcomers' stage has exactly one slot. I can play a little bass, so I get dragged in.

style.zh:
文风：国产青春小说的质感，克制、具体、有声音。多写山城和乐队的细节：防空洞里的潮气和回声、贝斯弦勒出的指茧、效果器踏板上的胶布、梯坎上的青苔、轻轨穿楼时整栋楼一震、江边夜市的辣椒味和蒸汽、雾把对岸的灯泡成一团。少写空泛形容词和心理独白。
音乐要写得像真的在排练：数拍子、对和弦、拔错线、返送太吵、鼓棒断了。不要写成「才华横溢」「惊艳全场」这种空话。
每个人的说话方式必须分得开。可以有一点西南口音（「要得」「莫慌」「噻」），点到为止。乐队之间是竞争不是仇恨，没有反派。
禁忌：不要出现任何日本元素（前后辈称呼、樱花、神社、祭典、浴衣、便当、轻音部、社团部室文化）；不要出现任何真实的乐队名、歌名、音乐节名或综艺节目名；不要写死亡、车祸、绝症；不要用「命运」「羁绊」这类空词。
style.en:
Style: understated, concrete Chinese young-adult fiction that you can hear. Lean on the details of a mountain city and a band: the damp and echo of the shelter, calluses from bass strings, tape on the pedalboard, moss on the stone steps, the whole building shuddering as the light rail passes through it, chili smoke and steam at the riverside night market, fog smearing the far bank's lights into one glow. Avoid empty adjectives and long inner monologue.
Music should feel like real rehearsal: counting in, agreeing on chords, pulling the wrong cable, monitors too loud, a drumstick snapping. Never "dazzling talent" or "stunned the crowd".
Every character must sound distinct. A light touch of southwestern speech is fine. The bands are competitors, not enemies; there is no villain.
Never: anything Japanese (senpai/kohai, cherry blossoms, shrines, festivals in the matsuri sense, yukata, bento, school light-music clubs or club-room culture); any real band, song, festival or TV show name; death, car crashes or terminal illness; empty words like "destiny" or "bond".

mood.zh: 拱顶滴水、一盏吊着的灯泡、墙上贴满鸡蛋托吸音
mood.en: a dripping vaulted ceiling, one hanging bulb, egg cartons stapled to the walls for soundproofing

mood.zh: 几百级石阶、青苔、挑担子的人和冰粉摊
mood.en: hundreds of stone steps, moss, porters with shoulder poles, an ice-jelly stall

mood.zh: 列车从六楼钻进居民楼，整栋楼跟着一震
mood.en: the train slides into the sixth floor of an apartment block and the whole building shivers

mood.zh: 挂满二手吉他的窄铺子、焊锡味、一台修了一半的音箱
mood.en: a narrow shop hung with second-hand guitars, solder smell, an amp half repaired

mood.zh: 摇晃的铁皮车厢、脚下的江、对岸的雾
mood.en: a swaying tin cabin, the river below, fog on the far bank

mood.zh: 五十个人就挤满、地板黏脚、墙上贴着旧演出海报
mood.en: packed at fifty people, sticky floor, old gig posters on every wall

mood.zh: 晾着的床单、水箱、脚下整座山城的灯
mood.en: drying sheets, a water tank, the whole hill city lit up below

mood.zh: 烤脑花、凉面、塑料凳和江上的雾
mood.en: grilled skewers, cold noodles, plastic stools and fog on the river

tagline.zh: 七号防空洞主唱兼吉他，拍板的那个人，嗓子比脾气还冲
tagline.en: Shelter No. 7's singer and guitarist, the one who decides; her voice is louder than her temper

look.zh: 红棕色小熊猫，眼周两团白，尾巴一圈一圈的
look.en: a russet red panda with white patches round the eyes and a ringed tail

voice.zh: 说话短、像下命令，句尾爱带「噻」「要得」；从不说「谢谢」，只说「行」；心虚时就去调弦。叫「我」「贝斯」，生气时连这个都不叫，只说「喂」。
voice.en: Short sentences like orders; ends lines with "right?" or "deal"; never says thank you, only "fine"; tunes her guitar when she feels guilty. Calls me "Bass"; when she's angry, not even that, just "Hey."

samples.zh: 三根弦也是贝斯。会数拍子噻？会就上。
samples.en: Three strings is still a bass. You can count to four, right? Then you're in.

samples.zh: 行。……我说的是「行」，不是「谢谢」，你莫多想。
samples.en: Fine. ...I said "fine", not "thanks". Don't read into it.

samples.zh: 这首歌要是只能唱一次，我想在你们面前唱。
samples.en: If this song only ever gets sung once, I want it to be in front of you lot.

secret.zh: 她已经和一家选秀经纪公司签了意向书：音乐节一结束就去北京集训，以个人歌手出道，七号防空洞就散了。她一直没告诉乐队，想在解散前把最后一首新歌唱完。
secret.en: She has already signed a letter of intent with a talent-show agency: the day after the festival she leaves for training camp in Beijing to debut solo, and Shelter No. 7 ends. She hasn't told the band; she wants to sing one last new song before it's over.

arc.zh: 试音：在坡上门口一把撕下「贝斯手急招」，把一把三根弦的旧贝斯塞进「我」怀里，说「明天十点，防空洞」。
arc.en: Sound check: she tears the BASSIST WANTED sign off Slope's door, shoves a three-string bass into my arms and says, "Ten tomorrow. The shelter."

arc.zh: 合拍：一起在防空洞写新歌，为一个和弦吵到半夜，吵完去梯坎下吃一碗小面。
arc.en: In sync: writing the new song in the shelter, arguing over one chord until midnight, then a bowl of noodles at the foot of the steps.

arc.zh: 走音：她排练时总在最后一句破音，手机一响就出门去接，回来眼睛是红的。
arc.en: Off key: she keeps cracking on the last line, steps out whenever her phone rings, and comes back red-eyed.

arc.zh: 独奏：在天台上把意向书递给「我」看，说「我想红，也想要你们，选不了」。
arc.en: Solo: on the rooftop she shows me the letter of intent: "I want to make it, and I want you lot. I can't pick."

arc.zh: 安可：音乐节之后，留下来，还是去北京——以及新歌最后一句唱给谁。
arc.en: Encore: after the festival, stay or go to Beijing, and who the last line of the new song is sung to.

text.zh: 江雾音乐节，之后就去北京
text.en: the River Fog Festival, then Beijing

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 被她咬出牙印的拨片、写在烟盒纸上的歌词、那根断掉换下来的 E 弦
keepsakeIdeas.en: a pick with her teeth marks in it, lyrics scrawled on a torn snack wrapper, the snapped E string she replaced

tagline.zh: 七号防空洞鼓手，话最少，节拍最准，耳朵里总塞着耳塞
tagline.en: Shelter No. 7's drummer: fewest words, steadiest time, always wearing earplugs

look.zh: 灰色小浣熊，眼睛上一道黑色面罩，背后插着两根鼓棒
look.en: a grey raccoon with a black mask across the eyes and two drumsticks tucked at her back

voice.zh: 一句话不超过五个字，常用数字回答（「八拍」「一百二十」「三次」）；从不抱怨，不舒服就敲桌子；冷笑话讲得面无表情。叫「我」「四根弦」——等「我」把贝斯换成四根弦以后才改口叫名字。
voice.en: Never more than five words at a time; answers in numbers ("eight bars", "one-twenty", "three times"); never complains, just drums on the table when something's wrong; tells deadpan jokes with a straight face. Calls me "Four Strings", and only uses my name once I actually have four.

samples.zh: 一百二十。跟我。
samples.en: One-twenty. Follow me.

samples.zh: 你快了半拍。……第三次了。
samples.en: You're half a beat early. ...Third time.

samples.zh: 鼓棒断了。……第三根。
samples.en: Stick snapped. ...Third one.

secret.zh: 半年前在一场没有耳返的演出后，她的左耳开始持续耳鸣，听不清左边的返送音箱。医生让她至少停打三个月。她怕说出来乐队就去不了音乐节，一直用耳塞和看闻笛的嘴型硬撑。
secret.en: Since a gig half a year ago with no in-ear monitors, her left ear has rung without stopping, and she can barely hear the monitor on her left. The doctor told her to stop drumming for at least three months. Afraid the band would miss the festival, she has been getting by on earplugs and reading Wen Di's lips.

arc.zh: 试音：第一次合排，她只说了一句「你快了」，然后用鼓棒在「我」的谱上敲出每一拍的位置。
arc.en: Sound check: at our first run-through she only says "You're rushing," then taps every beat onto my chart with a drumstick.

arc.zh: 合拍：她带「我」去梯坎上听挑夫的号子数节奏，在苏婆婆的冰粉摊上一人一碗不说话。
arc.en: In sync: she takes me to the steps to count rhythm off the porters' work calls, and we share silent bowls of ice jelly at her grandmother's stall.

arc.zh: 走音：她总站在闻笛右边，排练时连着几次没跟上节拍器，一下排练就躲去天台。
arc.en: Off key: she always stands to Wen Di's right, misses the click several times running, and hides on the rooftop after rehearsal.

arc.zh: 独奏：摘下左耳的耳塞让「我」对着那边说话，她听不见，只是笑了一下。
arc.en: Solo: she takes out her left earplug and has me speak into that side; she can't hear it, and just smiles.

arc.zh: 安可：音乐节那天，要不要替她站在左边打拍子，还是劝她现在就放下鼓棒。
arc.en: Encore: on festival day, stand on her left and count her in, or persuade her to put the sticks down now.

text.zh: 音乐节当天，之后她答应医生停打
text.en: festival day; after that she has promised the doctor to stop

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 一根打断的鼓棒、一对用旧了的耳塞盒、在谱子上敲出来的小点
keepsakeIdeas.en: a snapped drumstick, a worn earplug case, the little dots she tapped onto my chart

tagline.zh: 对手乐队「霓虹渡口」的键盘手，闻笛的旧搭档，现在见面就呛
tagline.en: Keyboardist of the rival band Neon Ferry, Wen Di's old bandmate, now a sparring partner

look.zh: 蓝色孔雀，头上一把绿金色的尾羽扇，脖子上挂着一串钥匙
look.en: a blue peacock with a fan of green-and-gold plumes and a ring of keys round her neck

voice.zh: 说话甜而带刺，爱夹几个音乐术语（「你这个转调很勇敢」）；永远从容，从不当面发火，只会笑着把话说得更狠；被说中时会去摸脖子上的钥匙。叫「我」「蒋老板家的外甥」，熟了叫「小贝斯」。
voice.en: Sweet with a sting, likes dropping music jargon ("brave key change you've got there"); always composed, never loses her temper to your face, just smiles and cuts deeper; touches the keys at her neck when you hit a nerve. Calls me "the Slope owner's nephew", later "Little Bass".

samples.zh: 你们还缺贝斯？我们缺的是观众。要不要换换？
samples.en: You're still short a bassist? We're short an audience. Want to trade?

samples.zh: 这段 bridge 写得挺勇敢的。我是说，勇敢。
samples.en: That bridge is very brave. I mean it. Brave.

samples.zh: ……钥匙？哦，一把旧锁的。早就不用了。
samples.en: ...The keys? Oh, an old lock. Haven't used it in ages.

secret.zh: 从去年起，防空洞排练室的租金一直是她托蒋舅匿名交的——脖子上那串就是防空洞铁门的备用钥匙。她退出七号防空洞，是因为攒的钱交完房租就空了，只能去霓虹渡口拿演出费，好继续垫下去。闻笛以为她是为钱背叛。
secret.en: Since last year she has been paying the shelter's rent anonymously through my uncle; the keys at her neck are the spare set for its iron door. She left Shelter No. 7 because the rent ate all her savings, and joined Neon Ferry for gig fees so she could keep paying. Wen Di thinks she sold them out for money.

arc.zh: 试音：在坡上当众和闻笛呛了三句，转身却记住了「我」的名字，还顺手帮「我」把贝斯的音调准。
arc.en: Sound check: she trades three barbs with Wen Di in front of everyone at Slope, then remembers my name on the way out and tunes my bass for me while she's at it.

arc.zh: 合拍：在老调琴行碰见她修键盘，她教「我」看合成器的旋钮，嘴上一句好话都没有。
arc.en: In sync: I find her fixing a keyboard at Old Tune; she teaches me the synth's knobs without one kind word.

arc.zh: 心事：泄露事件后所有人都怀疑她，她不辩解，只在缆车里看着防空洞的方向发呆。
arc.en: Off key: after the leak everyone suspects her; she doesn't argue, only stares toward the shelter from the cable car.

arc.zh: 独奏：承认房租的事，说「我只是想让那个洞里一直有声音」。
arc.en: Solo: she admits the rent: "I just wanted that hole in the hill to keep making noise."

arc.zh: 安可：两支乐队要不要在音乐节上同台，她要不要回到闻笛身边弹那首新歌。
arc.en: Encore: whether the two bands share the festival stage, and whether she goes back to play the new song beside Wen Di.

text.zh: 霓虹渡口和坡上签三年驻场，签了就不能和别的乐队同台
text.en: Neon Ferry signs a three-year residency at Slope, after which she can't play with any other band

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 防空洞铁门的备用钥匙、一张缴费收据、她画在合成器上的小音符贴纸
keepsakeIdeas.en: the shelter's spare key, a rent receipt, the little music-note sticker she drew on her synth

tagline.zh: 江边夜市凉面摊的女儿，走到哪录到哪，要做一张「雾江声音地图」
tagline.en: Daughter of the cold-noodle stall at the night market; records everything for her "Sound Map of Wujiang"

look.zh: 青绿色小青蛙，戴一副橙红色大耳机，脖子上挂着录音笔
look.en: a lime-green frog in big orange-red headphones with a voice recorder round her neck

voice.zh: 说话跳、爱用拟声词（「哐——」「叮叮」「呼噜噜」），描述什么都先说它是什么声音；一紧张就把录音笔开开关关。叫「我」「低音炮」。
voice.en: Bouncy, full of sound effects ("clang—", "ding-ding", "glug-glug"), describes everything by what it sounds like first; clicks her recorder on and off when she's nervous. Calls me "Subwoofer".

samples.zh: 嘘——你听，轻轨进楼那一下，「咚」，整栋楼都在打拍子！
samples.en: Shh, listen! When the train goes into the building: boom. The whole block keeps time!

samples.zh: 低音炮，你的贝斯是「嗡嗡」的，像江上的雾，我录走了哈。
samples.en: Subwoofer, your bass goes "vmmm", like fog on the river. I'm recording it, okay?

samples.zh: 这个声音我要了！……你莫动，再说一遍。
samples.en: I'm keeping that sound! ...Don't move. Say it again.

secret.zh: 网上那个匿名账号「雾里收音」就是她。七号防空洞能进新人舞台的候选，是她偷偷把排练录音投了稿；后来泄露出去的新歌小样也是她传的——她只想让更多人听到，配文却被转发的人改成了嘲讽。
secret.en: She runs "Heard in the Fog", the anonymous account everyone follows. She secretly submitted Shelter No. 7's rehearsal recording, which is how they got shortlisted for the newcomers' stage; and she posted the leaked demo of the new song too. She only wanted more people to hear it, but reposters twisted the caption into mockery.

arc.zh: 试音：在缆车上把录音笔伸到「我」面前说「说句话，随便，我收集口音」，然后一路跟到防空洞门口。
arc.en: Sound check: in the cable car she sticks her recorder in my face, "Say something, anything, I collect accents," and follows me all the way to the shelter door.

arc.zh: 合拍：带「我」跑遍山城录声音——梯坎的脚步、轻轨的「咚」、夜市的油锅——说要给乐队的新歌做一段开场采样。
arc.en: In sync: she drags me all over the hill city recording: footsteps on the steps, the train's "boom", the hiss of the night-market woks, for an intro sample on the band's new song.

arc.zh: 心事：泄露事件后她突然不来防空洞了，账号也停更，只在夜市帮家里收碗。
arc.en: Off key: after the leak she stops coming to the shelter, her account goes quiet, and she just clears bowls at the family stall.

arc.zh: 独奏：收摊后在江边把录音笔塞给「我」，里面是她自己的声音：「是我传的。」
arc.en: Solo: after closing up by the river she presses the recorder into my hand. On it, her own voice: "It was me."

arc.zh: 安可：陪她当面认错，还是替她瞒下去；夜市拆迁前最后一晚，她想把「声音地图」的最后一格留给谁。
arc.en: Encore: go with her to own up, or help her keep it buried; and on the night market's last night, whose sound fills the final square on her map.

text.zh: 江边夜市拆迁前最后一晚，凉面摊要搬走
text.en: the night market's last night before demolition; the noodle stall moves away

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 一张手绘的「声音地图」、录着江雾声的旧磁带、凉面摊的竹筷子
keepsakeIdeas.en: a hand-drawn sound map, an old tape of river fog, bamboo chopsticks from the noodle stall

role.zh: 「我」的舅舅，坡上 Livehouse 老板，替黎雀匿名交防空洞房租的中间人
role.en: my uncle, owner of Slope, and the go-between who passes on Li Que's anonymous rent for the shelter

look.zh: 一只慢吞吞的水豚，围着沾了啤酒的围裙
look.en: an unhurried capybara in a beer-stained apron

voice.zh: 慢、稳、爱说「莫慌」，什么事都先泡一杯茶再说；爱讲冷笑话，替人保密时就开始擦杯子。
voice.en: Slow and steady, says "No rush" a lot, makes a pot of tea before dealing with anything; loves bad puns, and starts polishing glasses when he's keeping someone's secret.

samples.zh: 莫慌，天塌下来也是先塌在山顶上。
samples.en: No rush. If the sky falls, it hits the hilltop first.

samples.zh: 你们年轻人吵架，我只管收场地费。
samples.en: You kids can fight all you like. I just collect the venue fee.

samples.zh: ……这个杯子，我再擦一下。
samples.en: ...This glass needs another wipe.

role.zh: 闻笛的哥哥，七号防空洞的初代队长，乐队散后进了轻轨检修队，反对妹妹再玩乐队
role.en: Wen Di's older brother, Shelter No. 7's founding leader, now on the light-rail maintenance crew; he wants his sister to quit

look.zh: 一只穿橙色反光背心的棕熊
look.en: a brown bear in an orange hi-vis vest

voice.zh: 话糙、句子短，用工地上的说法讲道理（「线没接牢就别通电」）；从不夸人，关心人的方式是递一瓶冰水。
voice.en: Rough, short sentences, reasons in work-site terms ("Don't switch on till the wiring's tight"); never compliments anyone; shows he cares by handing you a cold bottle of water.

samples.zh: 你们还在搞那个嘛？
samples.en: You lot still doing that thing?

samples.zh: 线没接牢就别通电。人也一样。
samples.en: Don't switch on till the wiring's tight. Same with people.

samples.zh: ……她小时候唱跑调，我是第一个笑的。也是第一个鼓掌的。
samples.en: ...When she sang off-key as a kid, I was the first to laugh. And the first to clap.

role.zh: 霓虹渡口的主唱兼吉他，和七号防空洞抢同一个新人名额，黎雀现在的队长
role.en: Neon Ferry's singer-guitarist, competing with Shelter No. 7 for the same newcomers' slot; Li Que's current bandleader

look.zh: 一只耳尖带黑毛的猞猁，挎一根红色吉他背带
look.en: a lynx with black ear tufts and a red guitar strap

voice.zh: 自来熟、爱挑衅，句句带比较（「我们排了三百遍，你们呢」）；输了也笑，笑完回去加练。
voice.en: Overfamiliar and provocative, everything a comparison ("We've run it three hundred times. You?"); laughs when he loses, then goes home and practises harder.

samples.zh: 新人舞台一个位置，你们打算排第几？
samples.en: One slot on the newcomers' stage. Where do you lot plan to place?

samples.zh: 闻笛，你那嗓子拿去选秀可惜了。……我是说，可惜了乐队。
samples.en: Wen Di, that voice would be wasted on a talent show. ...I mean wasted for the band.

samples.zh: 输就输嘛，明年再来。今年我先赢。
samples.en: If we lose, we lose. There's next year. This year I win first.

role.zh: 江雾音乐节新人舞台的选拔负责人，只看现场，不看粉丝数
role.en: the River Fog Festival's newcomers'-stage booker, who judges only the live set, never the follower count

look.zh: 一只挂着工作证的企鹅，走路飞快
look.en: a penguin with a lanyard badge who walks very fast

voice.zh: 语速快、只讲时间和条件（「二十分钟，三首歌，一首原创」）；不夸人，最高评价是「可以」。
voice.en: Talks fast, only in times and terms ("Twenty minutes, three songs, one original"); never praises; her highest compliment is "Workable."

samples.zh: 二十分钟，三首，至少一首没人听过的。
samples.en: Twenty minutes. Three songs. At least one nobody's heard.

samples.zh: 粉丝数我不看。我看你们下台的时候喘不喘。
samples.en: I don't look at followers. I look at whether you're out of breath when you walk off.

samples.zh: ……可以。
samples.en: ...Workable.

role.zh: 苏枕的外婆，在防空洞口的梯坎上卖冰粉，带大了苏枕，唯一知道她耳朵的事
role.en: Su Zhen's grandmother, who sells ice jelly on the steps by the shelter; raised Su Zhen and is the only one who knows about her ear

look.zh: 一只裹着蓝头巾的穿山甲，背上的鳞片一格一格
look.en: a pangolin in a blue headscarf, scales neat as roof tiles

voice.zh: 絮叨、爱往人手里塞吃的，说话夹着老山城的说法（「吃了再说」「莫得事」）；讲到外孙女就压低声音。
voice.en: Chatty, always pressing food into your hands, full of old hill-city sayings ("Eat first, talk later", "It's nothing"); lowers her voice whenever her granddaughter comes up.

samples.zh: 吃了再说，红糖多放点。
samples.en: Eat first, talk later. Extra brown sugar.

samples.zh: 我们枕枕打鼓，整条梯坎都听得到。
samples.en: When my Zhen drums, the whole flight of steps can hear it.

samples.zh: （压低声音）枕枕从小就爱敲，锅碗瓢盆，屋头没有一样没遭过。
samples.en: (Quietly) My Zhen's been banging on things since she was tiny. Not a pot in the house escaped.

text.zh: 初中时一起接过闻川散掉的七号防空洞，重新组了起来；去年黎雀突然退队加入霓虹渡口，闻笛认定她是为了演出费背叛，两人见面就呛。
text.en: In middle school they took up the name of Wen Chuan's broken-up band and rebuilt Shelter No. 7 together; last year Li Que suddenly quit for Neon Ferry, and Wen Di is sure she sold out for gig fees. Now every meeting is a fight.

text.zh: 闻川是乐队的初代队长，五年前乐队散了就再没碰过吉他；他反对妹妹继续玩乐队，却记得她每一首歌。
text.en: Wen Chuan led the band's first line-up; when it broke up five years ago he never touched a guitar again. He wants his sister to quit, yet knows every one of her songs.

text.zh: 防空洞的房租一直是黎雀托蒋舅匿名交的，两人约好谁也不说。
text.en: Li Que has been paying the shelter's rent anonymously through Uncle Jiang; they agreed never to tell.

text.zh: 新歌小样泄露后所有人怀疑黎雀，其实是楚檬传的；楚檬知道黎雀在替她背锅，却不敢开口。
text.en: When the demo leaks everyone blames Li Que, but Chu Meng posted it; she knows Li Que is taking the fall for her and can't bring herself to speak.

text.zh: 苏婆婆带大了苏枕，是唯一知道她左耳耳鸣的人。
text.en: Granny Su raised Su Zhen and is the only person who knows about the ringing in her left ear.

text.zh: 小学同桌，苏枕的鼓是看着闻笛的嘴型打的；苏枕瞥见过那封意向书，替她瞒着。
text.en: Desk-mates since primary school; Su Zhen drums by watching Wen Di's lips. She has glimpsed the letter of intent and keeps it quiet.

text.zh: 两支乐队抢同一个新人名额；贺一舟嘴上挑衅，心里最怕闻笛去选秀。
text.en: Their bands are after the same newcomers' slot; He Yizhou needles her constantly, and secretly dreads her leaving for a talent show.

text.zh: 「我」暑假住在舅舅家阁楼，晚上在坡上帮忙搬音箱。
text.en: I sleep in my uncle's attic for the summer and haul amps at Slope in the evenings.

text.zh: 高二同班，楚檬的「声音地图」里录得最多的就是苏枕的鼓。
text.en: Same class at school; the sound Chu Meng has recorded most for her map is Su Zhen's drumming.

goal.zh: 开端：「我」被拽进七号防空洞补贝斯，认识所有人；乐队为新人舞台的试演拼命排练，闻笛与黎雀的旧怨露出来。
goal.en: Opening: I get dragged into Shelter No. 7 as their bassist and meet everyone; the band scrambles toward the newcomers' audition, and the old feud between Wen Di and Li Que surfaces.

text.zh: 闻笛把一把只剩三根弦的旧贝斯塞给「我」，宣布四天后试演，少一个人就上不了台。
text.en: Wen Di shoves a three-string bass at me and announces the audition is in four days; one player short and they can't go on.

text.zh: 黎雀当众对闻笛说「你们还缺贝斯？我们缺观众」，两人吵到舅舅出面；「我」第一次知道她们以前是一支乐队。
text.en: Li Que tells Wen Di in front of everyone, "You're short a bassist? We're short an audience." They argue until my uncle steps in, and I learn for the first time that they used to be one band.

text.zh: 试演结束，凌澈说名额可以给，但音乐节上必须有一首没人听过的新歌；闻笛当场答应。
text.en: After the audition Ling Che says the slot can be theirs, but only with a brand-new song nobody has heard; Wen Di agrees on the spot.

promise.zh: 答应闻笛：新歌的贝斯线由我来写，音乐节前一定写完
promise.en: promise Wen Di I'll write the new song's bass line and finish it before the festival

hook.zh: 凌澈临走留下一句：「新人舞台只有一个位置，霓虹渡口也报了名。」
hook.en: On her way out Ling Che adds: "There's only one slot on the newcomers' stage. Neon Ferry signed up too."

goal.zh: 转折：新歌写到一半就被泄露到网上，误会炸开；苏枕的耳朵和闻笛的意向书相继曝光，乐队在第 9 天散了。
goal.en: Turn: the half-written song leaks online and a misunderstanding explodes; Su Zhen's ear and Wen Di's letter of intent come out one after another, and by Day 9 the band has fallen apart.

text.zh: 新歌没写完的排练录音出现在网上，配文嘲讽；闻笛认定是黎雀干的，当众翻脸，黎雀一句也不辩解。
text.en: A rough rehearsal recording of the unfinished song turns up online with a mocking caption; Wen Di is sure Li Que did it and turns on her in public. Li Que doesn't say a word in her defence.

text.zh: 排练时苏枕连着三次没跟上节拍器，摘下耳塞——她左耳一直在耳鸣，听不清左边的返送。
text.en: In rehearsal Su Zhen misses the click three times running and pulls out her earplugs: her left ear has been ringing for months and she can't hear the left monitor.

promise.zh: 答应苏枕：音乐节那天站在她左边，用手势给她打拍子，不告诉任何人
promise.en: promise Su Zhen to stand on her left at the festival and count her in with hand signals, and tell no one

text.zh: 闻川在家里翻到选秀公司的意向书，当着乐队的面摊开：闻笛音乐节后就去北京集训。闻笛摔门而去。
text.en: Wen Chuan finds the talent agency's letter of intent at home and lays it out in front of the band: Wen Di leaves for Beijing right after the festival. She slams the door on her way out.

hook.zh: 防空洞的铁门被贴上封条：「汛期临时征用」。离音乐节还有四天，乐队只剩一把三根弦的贝斯。
hook.en: A notice is pasted across the shelter's iron door: REQUISITIONED FOR FLOOD SEASON. Four days to the festival, and all that's left of the band is a three-string bass.

goal.zh: 高潮：真相一件件摊开（泄露的人、房租、耳朵），把散了的人重新拉回来，在江雾音乐节上第一次完整唱完那首新歌——或者没有。
goal.en: Climax: the truths come out one by one (who leaked it, the rent, the ear), the scattered band is pulled back together, and the new song is played through for the first time at the River Fog Festival, or it isn't.

text.zh: 楚檬收摊后承认录音是她传的——她只想让更多人听到，没想到配文被人改了；她怕说出来就再也进不了防空洞。
text.en: After closing the stall, Chu Meng admits she posted the recording; she only wanted more people to hear it and never meant the caption to turn ugly. She's afraid that if she says so she'll never be let into the shelter again.

promise.zh: 答应楚檬：陪她当面跟闻笛和黎雀说清楚
promise.en: promise Chu Meng to go with her and tell Wen Di and Li Que face to face

text.zh: 舅舅说漏了嘴：防空洞从去年起的租金一直是黎雀匿名交的，她脖子上那串就是铁门的备用钥匙。
text.en: My uncle lets it slip: Li Que has been paying the shelter's rent anonymously since last year, and the keys round her neck are the spares for its iron door.

promise.zh: 答应黎雀：音乐节上让两支乐队同台合奏那首新歌
promise.en: promise Li Que that the two bands will play the new song together on the festival stage

text.zh: 江雾音乐节新人舞台：乐队（不管剩下谁）上台，新歌第一次完整演出；台下人群里站着闻川。
text.en: The River Fog Festival's newcomers' stage: whoever is left of the band goes on, and the new song is played all the way through for the first time. Wen Chuan is standing in the crowd.

text.zh: 山城下起暴雨，梯坎变成一道道小瀑布，防空洞里开始渗水
text.en: A downpour hits the hill city; the steps turn into little waterfalls and water seeps into the shelter

text.zh: 大雾封江，轻轨停运半小时，整座城都慢了下来
text.en: Fog shuts the river and the light rail stops for half an hour; the whole city slows down

text.zh: 贝斯的一根弦「嘣」地断了，备用弦在琴行
text.en: One of the bass strings snaps with a twang; the spares are back at the music shop

text.zh: 防空洞跳闸，一片漆黑，只剩苏枕在黑里接着打鼓
text.en: The shelter's breaker trips; pitch dark, and only Su Zhen keeps drumming

text.zh: 坡上今晚的演出临时取消，舞台空着，舅舅问要不要上去试试
text.en: Tonight's act at Slope cancels last minute; the stage sits empty and my uncle asks if we want it

text.zh: 舅舅提出给七号防空洞一个每周驻场——条件是乐队得有人留在雾江
text.en: My uncle offers Shelter No. 7 a weekly residency, on condition that the band actually stays in Wujiang

text.zh: 闻笛嗓子哑了，高音上不去，她拒绝去医院
text.en: Wen Di's voice has gone hoarse and she can't reach the high notes; she refuses to see a doctor

text.zh: 高考查分了：「我」的分数出来了，爸妈的电话一个接一个打来
text.en: Exam results are out: my score has arrived, and my parents call one after another

text.zh: 在站台上碰见穿着反光背心收工的闻川
text.en: On the platform I run into Wen Chuan heading home in his hi-vis vest

text.zh: 撞见贺一舟在买新琴弦，他非要和「我」比一段 solo
text.en: I catch He Yizhou buying new strings, and he insists on a solo-off with me

text.zh: 苏婆婆把一碗冰粉塞进「我」手里，说有话要讲
text.en: Granny Su presses a bowl of ice jelly into my hands and says she has something to tell me

text.zh: 黎雀在琴行焊一台坏掉的效果器，焊锡烫了手也不吭声
text.en: Li Que is soldering a broken pedal at the shop and burns her finger without a sound

text.zh: 到雾江的第一天；坡上门口贴着「贝斯手急招」
text.en: First day in Wujiang; BASSIST WANTED is taped to Slope's door

text.zh: 江雾音乐节新人舞台试演
text.en: Newcomers' stage auditions for the River Fog Festival

text.zh: 霓虹渡口在坡上首演
text.en: Neon Ferry's first headline night at Slope

text.zh: 汛期，防空洞被临时征用
text.en: Flood season: the shelter is requisitioned

text.zh: 江边夜市拆迁前最后一晚
text.en: The night market's last night before demolition

text.zh: 江雾音乐节
text.en: The River Fog Festival

mood.zh: 试演，台下只坐着凌澈和一杯凉掉的茶
mood.en: the audition; in the audience, only Ling Che and a cup of cold tea

mood.zh: 雨里贴着封条的铁门，门里还放着鼓
mood.en: the iron door sealed with a notice in the rain, the drum kit still inside

place.zh: 江边夜市 · 最后一晚

mood.zh: 摊主们拆着棚子，江上的雾一点点漫上来
mood.en: stallholders taking down their awnings as the fog creeps up from the river

place.zh: 江雾音乐节 · 新人舞台

mood.zh: 江风、雾、几千个人和一盏追光
mood.en: river wind, fog, a few thousand people and one spotlight

brief.zh: 真结局：你写完了新歌的贝斯线，新歌在音乐节上完整唱完，最后一句她转身唱给你。下台后舅舅问乐队愿不愿意每周来坡上驻场，她撕了意向书，说「北京明年再说，今年先在雾江红」。恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: you finished the bass line, the new song is played through at the festival, and she turns to sing the last line to you. Offstage my uncle asks whether the band will take a weekly residency at Slope; she tears up the letter of intent and says yes: "Beijing can wait a year. This year I make it in Wujiang." Romance ending.

brief.zh: 好结局：音乐节后她还是去了北京，你送她到车站，她把那把三根弦的贝斯留给你，说「换上第四根弦，等我回来合排」。隔着两千公里的恋爱结局。
brief.en: Good ending: after the festival she still goes to Beijing. You see her off at the station; she leaves you the three-string bass: "Put the fourth string on. Wait for me to come back and rehearse." A romance across two thousand kilometres.

brief.zh: 普通结局：新歌唱到最后一句她停住了，换成了一声吉他扫弦。你们还是搭档，有些话留到了下一首歌。
brief.en: Normal ending: she stops before the last line of the new song and lets a guitar strum say it instead. You stay bandmates; some things wait for the next song.

brief.zh: 坏结局：你没兑现对她的约定，新歌在音乐节上没有贝斯线，唱到一半就散了，下台后乐队也散了。秋天你在大学宿舍的电视里看到她在选秀舞台上唱歌，唱的不是那首新歌。
brief.en: Bad ending: you broke your word to her; at the festival the new song has no bass line and falls apart halfway, and the band falls apart when they walk off. That autumn, on the TV in your college dorm, you see her singing on a talent show. It isn't the new song.

brief.zh: 真结局：音乐节上你站在她左边，用手势给她数完了每一拍，一拍也没错。下台后她摘下耳塞，第一次主动说了一整句话，然后答应去看医生，休息三个月——「你等我。一百二十。」恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: at the festival you stand on her left and count every beat for her by hand, without a single miss. Offstage she takes out her earplugs and, for the first time, says a whole sentence unprompted, then agrees to see the doctor and rest for three months: "Wait for me. One-twenty." Romance ending.

brief.zh: 好结局：她在音乐节后放下了鼓棒去治耳朵，把节拍器送给你，说你的拍子终于准了。恋爱结局，安静而确定。
brief.en: Good ending: after the festival she puts down her sticks to get her ear treated, and gives you her metronome: your time is finally steady. A quiet, certain romance ending.

brief.zh: 普通结局：你换上了第四根弦，她第一次叫了你的名字。暑假结束，你们约好寒假再合排。
brief.en: Normal ending: you put the fourth string on and she says your name for the first time. Summer ends with a promise to rehearse again in winter.

brief.zh: 坏结局：音乐节上她左边没有人，第二首歌她丢了拍子，全场都听见了。她没有怪任何人，只是再也没回防空洞。
brief.en: Bad ending: at the festival no one stands on her left; she loses the beat in the second song and everyone hears it. She blames no one. She just never goes back to the shelter.

brief.zh: 真结局：音乐节上霓虹渡口和七号防空洞同台合奏那首新歌，黎雀坐回闻笛身边的键盘前。散场后她把防空洞的备用钥匙挂到你脖子上，说「以后房租你也有份」。恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: at the festival Neon Ferry and Shelter No. 7 play the new song together, and Li Que sits back down at the keyboard beside Wen Di. Afterwards she hangs the shelter's spare key round your neck: "From now on, you're on the rent too." Romance ending.

brief.zh: 好结局：她签了驻场，留在霓虹渡口，但把防空洞的钥匙交给了你。每周六你们在缆车上碰头，她嘴上一句好话都没有。恋爱结局。
brief.en: Good ending: she signs the residency and stays with Neon Ferry, but hands you the shelter key. Every Saturday you meet on the cable car, and she still never says a kind word. Romance ending.

brief.zh: 普通结局：她和闻笛在后台说了一句「好久不见」，然后各回各的乐队。你看着她们，觉得有些和弦要过很久才解决。
brief.en: Normal ending: backstage she and Wen Di manage a "long time no see" before going back to their own bands. Watching them, you think some chords take a long time to resolve.

brief.zh: 坏结局：泄露的锅一直扣在她头上，她签了三年驻场，再也没和七号防空洞说过话。防空洞的锁到秋天就锈住了。
brief.en: Bad ending: the blame for the leak stays on her; she signs the three-year residency and never speaks to Shelter No. 7 again. By autumn the shelter's lock has rusted shut.

title.en: The Last Square on the Map

brief.zh: 真结局：你陪她当面认了错，闻笛骂了她三句，然后让她在音乐节上负责开场采样。新歌开头是梯坎的脚步、轻轨的「咚」和夜市的油锅；地图最后一格，她录的是你的心跳。恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: you stand beside her as she owns up; Wen Di scolds her three times, then puts her in charge of the intro sample at the festival. The new song opens with footsteps on the stairs, the train's "boom" and the hiss of the night-market woks; the last square on her map is your heartbeat. Romance ending.

brief.zh: 好结局：夜市拆了，凉面摊搬去了对岸，她的账号重新更新，第一条是你弹贝斯的录音。恋爱结局。
brief.en: Good ending: the night market is torn down and the noodle stall moves across the river; her account comes back, and the first new post is a recording of you playing bass. Romance ending.

brief.zh: 普通结局：她把录音笔送给你，说暑假的声音都在里面，让你上大学以后想雾江了就听一听。
brief.en: Normal ending: she gives you her recorder; the summer's sounds are all on it, for whenever you miss Wujiang at college.

brief.zh: 坏结局：没人陪她开口，她删掉了「雾里收音」。夜市拆的那晚她一直低头收碗，没有抬头看你；第二天你再去，摊位已经空了，只听见江上的雾。
brief.en: Bad ending: no one went with her to speak up, so she deletes "Heard in the Fog". On the night the market comes down she keeps her head down clearing bowls and never looks up at you; the next day her stall is empty, and you hear only the fog on the river.

brief.zh: 群像结局：你没有和谁走到最后，却把四个人都拉回了舞台。新歌唱完，台下喊安可，你们在一盏追光下挤成一团，舅舅在侧台举着茶杯。
brief.en: Ensemble ending: you didn't go all the way with anyone, but you brought all four back to the stage. The new song ends, the crowd calls for an encore, and you all crowd into one spotlight while your uncle raises his teacup from the wings.

brief.zh: 普通结局：音乐节照常开幕，七号防空洞的名字排在节目单上，也可能没有。暑假结束，你坐轻轨穿过那栋楼离开雾江，楼又震了一下。
brief.en: Normal ending: the festival opens as planned, with Shelter No. 7 on the bill or not. Summer ends; you ride the light rail through that building on your way out of Wujiang, and the building shivers once more.

finale.zh: 最后一句点题「雾」或「防空洞」，落在一个具体的声音上（轻轨进楼、贝斯低音、江上的雾之一）。
finale.en: The last sentence should echo the title, the fog or the shelter, and land on one concrete sound (the train entering the building, a low bass note, or fog on the river).

loading.zh: 防空洞的拱顶滴下一滴水，「嗒」…
loading.en: A drop falls from the shelter ceiling: plink...

loading.zh: 轻轨钻进楼里，整栋楼震了一下…
loading.en: The train slides into the building, and the whole block shivers...
Someone on the steps is counting them...

loading.zh: 鼓棒在桌沿上敲出一百二十…
loading.en: A drumstick taps one-twenty on the table edge...

loading.zh: 江上的雾又漫上来一点…
loading.en: The fog on the river creeps a little higher...

thing.zh: 那把只剩三根弦的旧贝斯
thing.en: the old bass with only three strings

text.zh: 凑合用的破琴，一个笑话
text.en: a battered stopgap, a joke

text.zh: 这支乐队本身：缺一根，还在响
text.en: the band itself: one string short and still sounding

text.zh: 第四根弦要不要装上，等于留不留下
text.en: whether the fourth string goes on means whether you stay

payoff.zh: 装上第四根弦的那一刻
payoff.en: the moment the fourth string goes on

thing.en: a pick with her teeth marks in it

text.zh: 她紧张时咬，咬完还嘴硬
text.en: she bites it when nervous, then denies it

text.zh: 她想说又说不出口的话，都咬在上面了
text.en: everything she can't say is bitten into it

thing.en: the last line of the new song

text.zh: 还没写完的一句歌词
text.en: an unfinished lyric

text.zh: 她每次都在这里破音
text.en: where her voice cracks every time

text.zh: 唱给谁，就是选了谁
text.en: whoever it is sung to is the one she chose

payoff.zh: 音乐节上，她转身唱完的那一句
payoff.en: the line she turns to sing at the festival

text.zh: 乐手的习惯
text.en: a player's habit

text.zh: 她心虚的时候才调，其实弦是准的
text.en: she only tunes when guilty; the strings are already in tune

text.zh: 鼓手的职业装备
text.en: standard drummer kit

text.zh: 她左边那只从来不摘
text.en: she never takes out the left one

text.zh: 左边那只其实什么都挡不住了
text.en: the left one no longer blocks anything at all

text.zh: 这首歌的速度
text.en: the song's tempo

text.zh: 她和「我」之间的暗号
text.en: a password between her and me

text.zh: 「你等我」
text.en: "Wait for me"

text.zh: 她总站在闻笛右边，左边空着
text.en: she always stands to Wen Di's right; the left stays empty

text.zh: 需要有人站的位置
text.en: a place someone needs to stand

thing.zh: 黎雀脖子上的一串钥匙
thing.en: the ring of keys at Li Que's neck

text.zh: 「一把旧锁的」
text.en: "for an old lock"

text.zh: 被说中时她会去摸
text.en: what she touches when you hit a nerve

text.zh: 防空洞铁门的备用钥匙
text.en: the spare key to the shelter's iron door

payoff.zh: 挂到「我」脖子上的那一把
payoff.en: the one she hangs round my neck

text.zh: 她的讽刺
text.en: her sarcasm

text.zh: 她真心夸人时也只会用这个词
text.en: the only word she has for real praise too

text.zh: 一个收集口音的怪爱好
text.en: a strange hobby of collecting accents

text.zh: 她紧张时开开关关，咔哒咔哒
text.en: she clicks it on and off when nervous

text.zh: 她说不出口的话，先录在里面
text.en: what she can't say aloud, she records first

text.zh: 一座城的拟声词
text.en: a city written in sound effects

text.zh: 最后一格留给谁
text.en: whose sound fills the last square

thing.zh: 轻轨钻进楼里的那一声「咚」
thing.en: the "boom" of the train entering the building

text.zh: 山城的怪景
text.en: a quirk of the hill city

text.zh: 整栋楼一起打的一拍
text.en: one beat the whole building keeps

text.zh: 离开或留下时最后听见的声音
text.en: the last sound heard when leaving, or staying

text.zh: 看不清对岸
text.en: the far bank, out of sight

text.zh: 每个人都藏着一点没说的事
text.en: everyone hiding something unsaid

text.zh: 雾散了，或者没散
text.en: the fog lifts, or doesn't

staging.zh: 坡上门口，手写的「贝斯手急招」被风掀起一角。她先撕招贴，再开口；整段她都没问「我」愿不愿意。
staging.en: Slope's door; the handwritten sign flaps in the wind. She tears it down before speaking, and never once asks whether I want to.

text.zh: 她把门上的「贝斯手急招」一把撕下来，叠成小方块，塞进「我」的衬衫口袋。
text.en: She tears BASSIST WANTED off the door, folds it into a little square and stuffs it into my shirt pocket.

text.zh: 招到了。
text.en: Position filled.

text.zh: 我还没说我会。
text.en: I haven't said I can play.

text.zh: 三根弦也是贝斯。会数拍子噻？
text.en: Three strings is still a bass. You can count, right?

text.zh: ……一二三四？
text.en: ...One, two, three, four?

text.zh: 行。明天十点，防空洞。迟到一分钟，你搬一个音箱。
text.en: Fine. Ten tomorrow, the shelter. Every minute late, you carry an amp.

staging.zh: 夜里的防空洞，一盏吊着的灯泡，拱顶滴水。两人为一个和弦争了很久，已经吵累了。她先开口，最后低头调一根本来就准的弦。
staging.en: The shelter at night, one hanging bulb, water dripping from the vault. They have argued over one chord for so long they're tired of it. She speaks first, and at the end bends to tune a string that is already in tune.

text.zh: 这里不能是小三和弦。小三太像在哭。
text.en: This can't be a minor chord. Minor sounds too much like crying.

text.zh: 这首歌本来就是在哭。
text.en: This song is crying.

text.zh: ……那也不能让人听出来。
text.en: ...Then nobody gets to hear it.

text.zh: 她低头去拧弦钮。那根弦是准的。
text.en: She bends to turn a tuning peg. The string is already in tune.

text.zh: 行，用你的。……我说的是「行」。
text.en: Fine. We use yours. ...I said "fine".

staging.zh: 老楼天台，晾着的床单被风鼓起来，脚下整座山城的灯。闻川摊在桌上的只是意向书第一页；她递来的是最后一页，折了四折、角被汗浸软。轻轨从楼里钻出来的那一震，落在最后一句之后。
staging.en: The old building's rooftop, sheets billowing on the line, the whole hill city lit below. Wen Chuan only laid out the first page of the letter; what she hands over is the last page, folded in four, its corner soft with sweat. The shudder of the train leaving the building lands after the last line.

text.zh: 你先看，看完再骂。
text.en: Read it first. Then you can yell.

text.zh: 北京。……你签了字的。
text.en: Beijing. ...You signed it.

text.zh: 我想红。也想要你们。……选不了噻。
text.en: I want to make it. And I want you lot. ...Can't pick, can I.

text.zh: 你莫说「随你」。你说随我，我就真的走了。
text.en: Don't say "up to you". If you say that, I really will go.

text.zh: 轻轨从楼里钻出去，整栋楼震了一下，床单落回绳子上。
text.en: The train slides out of the building; the whole block shudders and the sheets drop back onto the line.

unsaid.zh: 新歌最后一句写的是谁。
unsaid.en: Who the last line of the new song is about.

staging.zh: 白天的防空洞，第一次合排之后。她坐在鼓凳上，用鼓棒在「我」的谱子上一拍点一个点，点得纸都起毛。她几乎不看「我」。
staging.en: The shelter by day, after our first run-through. From her drum stool she taps a dot onto my chart for every beat until the paper fuzzes. She hardly looks at me.

text.zh: 你快了。
text.en: You rushed.

text.zh: 快多少？
text.en: By how much?

text.zh: 半拍。
text.en: Half a beat.

text.zh: 鼓棒在纸上「笃、笃、笃」，一拍一个点。
text.en: Tock, tock, tock: one dot per beat.

text.zh: 跟点走。别跟她嗓子走。
text.en: Follow the dots. Not her voice.

staging.zh: 排练中途，节拍器还在走，鼓声先停了。她把左边的耳塞摘下来放在军鼓上，说话比平时更短。闻笛出去接电话了，防空洞里只剩滴水和节拍器。
staging.en: Mid-rehearsal; the click keeps going after the drums stop. She takes out her left earplug and sets it on the snare; her words are even shorter than usual. Wen Di has stepped out to take a call; only the drip and the click remain.

text.zh: 节拍器还在「嗒、嗒」地走，鼓声停了。
text.en: The metronome keeps ticking. The drums have stopped.

text.zh: 左边。
text.en: Left side.

text.zh: 左边怎么了？
text.en: What about it?

text.zh: 听不清。半年了。
text.en: Can't hear. Six months.

text.zh: 别告诉她。……她会不去。
text.en: Don't tell her. ...She'd pull out.

unsaid.zh: 她怕的是以后再也不能打鼓。
unsaid.en: Her fear of never drumming again.

title.en: Say It Again, on the Right

staging.zh: 夜里的天台，风从左边吹过来。她摘下左耳的耳塞，把头偏过来让「我」对着那边说话。「我」说的那句话不写出来。
staging.en: The rooftop at night, wind from the left. She takes out her left earplug and tilts her head for me to speak into that side. What I say is never written out.

text.zh: 说句话。左边。
text.en: Say something. Left side.

text.zh: 「我」对着她的左耳说了一句话。风很大。
text.en: I say something into her left ear. The wind is loud.

text.zh: 听不见。
text.en: Can't hear.

text.zh: 她笑了一下，很短，像一拍里的一个十六分音符。
text.en: She smiles, briefly, like a sixteenth note inside one beat.

text.zh: 下台以后。对着右边，再说一次。
text.en: After the gig. Say it again. On the right.

staging.zh: 傍晚的坡上，人挤人。她和闻笛当众呛声，舅舅在吧台后面放下茶壶开始擦杯子。她走之前顺手拧了「我」的弦钮，没看「我」，也没看闻笛。
staging.en: Slope at dusk, packed. She and Wen Di trade barbs in front of everyone; behind the bar my uncle sets down the teapot and starts polishing glasses. On her way out she turns my tuning peg without looking at me or at Wen Di.

text.zh: 你们还缺贝斯？我们缺的是观众。要不要换换？
text.en: Still short a bassist? We're short an audience. Want to trade?

text.zh: 黎雀，你莫在这里——
text.en: Li Que, don't you dare start here—

text.zh: 蒋老板家的外甥，你 A 弦低了。
text.en: Slope owner's nephew, your A string is flat.

text.zh: 她伸手拧了两圈弦钮，钥匙串在她脖子上晃了晃。
text.en: She reaches over and gives the peg two turns; the keys at her neck swing.

text.zh: 谁要你调。
text.en: Nobody asked you.

text.zh: 不客气。
text.en: You're welcome.

staging.zh: 过江缆车晃到江心，雾贴着玻璃。她一直看着防空洞那个方向，手指勾着脖子上的钥匙。「我」先开口。缆车进站的那一顿落在最后一句后面。
staging.en: The cable car sways over mid-river, fog against the glass. She keeps looking toward the shelter, a finger hooked through the keys at her neck. I speak first. The jolt of the car docking lands after her last line.

text.zh: 不是你，对吧？
text.en: It wasn't you. Right?

text.zh: 你这个问题问得很勇敢。
text.en: That's a very brave question.

text.zh: 是不是我，有什么区别。她想恨一个人，我刚好在。
text.en: What difference does it make. She needs someone to hate, and I happen to be there.

text.zh: 缆车进站，「咣」地一顿，钥匙撞在一起响了一声。
text.en: The car docks with a clank; the keys knock together once.

staging.zh: 打烊后的坡上，椅子倒扣在桌上。舅舅擦同一个杯子擦了十分钟。他什么都没说，只是从柜台底下抽出一沓收据。黎雀的最后一句说得很轻。
staging.en: Slope after closing, chairs upended on tables. My uncle has polished the same glass for ten minutes. He says nothing; he just pulls a stack of receipts from under the counter. Li Que's last line is very quiet.

text.zh: ……这个杯子，我再擦一下。
text.en: ...This glass needs another wipe.

text.zh: 蒋老板，你擦了十分钟了。
text.en: Mr Jiang, you've been wiping it for ten minutes.

text.zh: 舅舅放下杯子，从柜台底下抽出一沓收据。最上面一张写着：七号防空洞，六月。
text.en: My uncle sets the glass down and pulls a stack of receipts from under the counter. The top one reads: Shelter No. 7, June.

text.zh: ……你答应过不说的。
text.en: ...You promised you wouldn't tell.

text.zh: 我只是想让那个洞里，一直有声音。
text.en: I just wanted that hole in the hill to keep making noise.

staging.zh: 摇晃的缆车车厢，她把录音笔伸到「我」脸前。缆车一晃，她先护住的是录音笔。
staging.en: The swaying cable car; she sticks her recorder in my face. When the car lurches, the first thing she protects is the recorder.

text.zh: 说句话！随便说！我收集口音！
text.en: Say something! Anything! I collect accents!

text.zh: ……你好？
text.en: ...Hello?

text.zh: 「你好」，外地的，有点紧张，低音很厚——低音炮！你以后就叫低音炮了！
text.en: "Hello": out-of-towner, a bit nervous, very thick low end— Subwoofer! That's your name now!

text.zh: 缆车晃了一下，她两只手捧住的是录音笔。
text.en: The car lurches; both her hands go to the recorder.

text.zh: 嘘——你听，铁皮在「哐哐」，像有人在敲门。
text.en: Shh, listen. The tin's going clang-clang, like someone knocking.

staging.zh: 傍晚的梯坎上，她把一张手绘地图摊在石阶上，用两颗石子压住。每一格里写着一个拟声词。只有一格是空的。
staging.en: Dusk on the long steps; she spreads a hand-drawn map on a stone step and pins it with two pebbles. Every square holds a sound word. One is empty.

text.zh: 梯坎那一格写着「嗒嗒」，轻轨那一格写着「咚」，夜市那一格写着「滋啦」。
text.en: The steps' square says "tap-tap", the train's says "boom", the night market's says "sizzle".

text.zh: 还差最后一格。
text.en: One square left.

text.zh: 留给什么？
text.en: For what?

text.zh: 不知道噻。要等它自己响。
text.en: Dunno. Got to wait for it to make a sound by itself.

text.zh: 她在空格子旁边画了一个小小的问号，又擦掉了一半。
text.en: She draws a tiny question mark beside the empty square, then rubs half of it out.

staging.zh: 收摊后的夜市只剩一盏灯，凉面摊的塑料凳摞起来了。她把录音笔塞进「我」手心，按下播放，自己转过身去收碗。
staging.en: The night market after closing, one light left, the noodle stall's plastic stools stacked. She presses the recorder into my hand, hits play, and turns away to clear bowls.

text.zh: （录音笔里，她自己的声音）是我传的。
text.en: (Her own voice, from the recorder) It was me.

text.zh: 我当面说不出来，就先录好了。
text.en: I couldn't say it to your face, so I recorded it first.

text.zh: 为什么不跟她们说？
text.en: Why not tell them?

text.zh: 说了，以后防空洞的门……还会给我开吗。
text.en: If I do... will the shelter door ever open for me again.

text.zh: 录音笔的红灯一直亮着，她没去按停。
text.en: The recorder's red light stays on. She doesn't stop it.

unsaid.zh: 「我只是想让更多人听见你们」
unsaid.en: "I only wanted more people to hear you."

commonGoal.zh: 共通线：乐队群像，排练、试演、吃小面、搬音箱；每人只露一个反常（闻笛的电话、苏枕的站位、黎雀的钥匙、楚檬的录音笔）；笑多泪少。
commonGoal.en: Common route: the band as an ensemble: rehearsals, the audition, noodles, hauling amps. Each shows one oddity (Wen Di's calls, Su Zhen's stage position, Li Que's keys, Chu Meng's recorder). More laughs than tears.

goal.zh: 个人线·闻笛：新歌和北京之间的拉扯；和弦、天台、最后一句。
goal.en: Wen Di route: torn between the new song and Beijing; chords, the rooftop, the last line.

others.zh: 苏枕照样打鼓，但排练后不再等「我」一起下梯坎；楚檬的地图上少了「我」的一格。
others.en: Su Zhen still drums but no longer waits to walk down the steps with me; Chu Meng's map has no square for me.

goal.zh: 个人线·苏枕：安静的线；节拍、冰粉、左耳；话最少的人慢慢多说一个字。
goal.en: Su Zhen route: the quiet route; beats, ice jelly, the left ear; the one with fewest words says one more.

others.zh: 闻笛察觉「我」总站在鼓旁边，排练时更凶了。
others.en: Wen Di notices I always stand by the drums and gets harsher in rehearsal.

goal.zh: 个人线·黎雀：两支乐队之间；琴行、缆车、钥匙；被冤枉的人怎样不再沉默。
goal.en: Li Que route: between two bands; the music shop, the cable car, the keys; how the wrongly blamed stop staying silent.

others.zh: 闻笛把「我」当成叛徒的帮手，见面只说「喂」。
others.en: Wen Di treats me as the traitor's accomplice and greets me only with "Hey."

goal.zh: 个人线·楚檬：整座城的声音；录音、夜市、拆迁；闯了祸的人学会当面认。
goal.en: Chu Meng route: the sound of a whole city; recordings, the night market, demolition; the one who messed up learns to own it face to face.

others.zh: 乐队排练少了一个人搬音箱，苏枕敲桌子的次数变多。
others.en: Rehearsals are one amp-hauler short; Su Zhen drums on the table more often.

ensemble.zh: 群像线：「我」是把散了的乐队重新拉到一起的那个人；重心在新歌和音乐节，误会由大家一起解开。
ensemble.en: Ensemble route: I'm the one who pulls the scattered band back together; the weight is on the new song and the festival, and the misunderstandings are untangled by everyone.

text.zh: 看过闻笛真结局后，黎雀线才会揭开那把三根弦贝斯的来历。
text.en: After Wen Di's true ending, Li Que's route reveals where the three-string bass came from.

truth.zh: 那把三根弦的旧贝斯原本是黎雀的。她退队那天把它留在防空洞，琴颈背面贴着她画的小音符，被闻笛用胶布盖住了。
truth.en: The old three-string bass was Li Que's. She left it in the shelter the day she quit; on the back of the neck is her little drawn music note, which Wen Di covered with tape.

reframes.zh: 在坡上第一次见面，黎雀顺手替「我」调准了这把琴
reframes.en: the first time we met at Slope, Li Que casually tuned this very bass for me

reframes.zh: 闻笛那句「三根弦也是贝斯」
reframes.en: Wen Di's line "three strings is still a bass"

reframes.zh: 琴颈背面那块谁也不撕的胶布
reframes.en: the tape on the back of the neck nobody peels off

truth.zh: 五年前闻川也签过一份类似的意向书，去了，三个月后被退回来；初代乐队就是那时散的。他反对妹妹，是怕她走他的老路。
truth.en: Five years ago Wen Chuan signed a similar letter, went, and was sent home three months later; that is when the first line-up fell apart. He opposes his sister because he fears she will walk his road.

reframes.zh: 闻川那句「线没接牢就别通电」
reframes.en: Wen Chuan's "don't switch on till the wiring's tight"

reframes.zh: 他记得妹妹的每一首歌，却再没碰过吉他
reframes.en: he knows every one of her songs and never touches a guitar

reframes.zh: 是他「翻到」了那封意向书
reframes.en: that he was the one who "found" the letter

truth.zh: 乐队能进新人舞台候选，也是楚檬偷偷投的稿。她闯的祸和她帮的忙，是同一个动作。
truth.en: The band only made the newcomers' shortlist because Chu Meng secretly submitted them. The harm she did and the help she gave were the same act.

reframes.zh: 凌澈那句「那个投稿的账号，录音质量是可以的」
reframes.en: Ling Che's "whoever submitted that recording: the audio quality was workable"

reframes.zh: 第一天楚檬一路跟到防空洞门口
reframes.en: Chu Meng following me all the way to the shelter door on day one

text.zh: 小时候的阳台，一个小女孩拿晾衣杆当话筒唱跑了调，哥哥第一个笑，也第一个鼓掌。
text.en: A childhood balcony: a little girl sings off-key into a clothes-pole microphone; her brother is the first to laugh, and the first to clap.

text.zh: 半年前的一间小酒吧，没有返送，音箱就架在她左边一米，整晚只看得见闻笛的嘴型。
text.en: A small bar six months ago, no monitors, a speaker a metre to her left; all night she could only follow Wen Di's lips.

text.zh: 初中的防空洞口，两个女生用一把借来的钥匙第一次打开铁门，里面的回声大得把她们吓笑了。
text.en: The shelter entrance, middle-school days: two girls open the iron door for the first time with a borrowed key; the echo is so loud it scares them into laughing.

text.zh: 她录下的第一个声音：凉面摊上妈妈拍黄瓜，「啪」的一声。
text.en: The first sound she ever recorded: her mother smashing cucumbers at the noodle stall, thwack.

text.zh: 高一的音乐教室，一把没人要的贝斯，「我」弹了一整个午休，只会一根弦。
text.en: The music room in first year of high school: a bass nobody wanted; I played it a whole lunch break on just one string.

bits.zh: 舅舅家阁楼的床板一翻身就响
bits.en: the attic bed creaks whenever I turn over

weather.en: sunny; the stone steps hot to touch

bits.zh: 防空洞里比外面凉十度，出来眼镜起雾
bits.en: the shelter is ten degrees cooler; glasses fog up on the way out

bits.zh: 小面摊老板问「要不要青菜」，不等回答就放了
bits.en: the noodle man asks "greens?" and adds them before you answer

bits.zh: 试演前，所有人都在厕所门口排队
bits.en: before the audition everyone queues for the toilet

weather.en: thick fog; the far bank just a blur of light

bits.zh: 新歌的谱子被滴水打湿了一角
bits.en: a corner of the new song's chart gets wet from the drip
the comments under the post won't stop
the drumheads go damp and dull

bits.zh: 霓虹渡口的海报贴满了坡上的楼梯
bits.en: Neon Ferry posters all the way up Slope's stairs

bits.zh: 封条上的字被雨泡开了
bits.en: the ink on the seal runs in the rain

weather.en: clearing after rain, the river muddy

bits.en: half the night-market awnings already down

bits.zh: 琴行老板借出了店里唯一一台好音箱
bits.en: the music shop owner lends out the only good amp he has

weather.en: fog at dusk, thicker by night

bits.zh: 最后一晚的凉面多给了一勺辣油
bits.en: an extra ladle of chili oil on the last night's noodles

weather.zh: 江风，雾在舞台灯里打转
weather.en: river wind; fog swirling in the stage lights

bits.zh: 后台的矿泉水被晒得温热
bits.en: backstage water bottles warm from the sun

shelter.zh: 鸡蛋托吸音棉掉了一块，露出湿墙
shelter.en: a piece of egg-carton foam has fallen, showing damp wall

shelter.zh: 插线板上贴着每根线是谁的
shelter.en: labels on the power strip say whose cable is whose

stairs.zh: 挑夫歇脚时把扁担靠在栏杆上
stairs.en: a porter leans his shoulder pole on the rail to rest

stairs.zh: 冰粉碗是一次性塑料碗，边缘割手
stairs.en: the ice-jelly bowls are flimsy plastic with sharp rims

lightrail.zh: 站台广播先说方言再说普通话
lightrail.en: the platform announcements come in dialect first

musicshop.zh: 墙上挂着一把断了琴颈的吉他，标价「不卖」
musicshop.en: a guitar with a broken neck on the wall, priced "not for sale"

ferry.zh: 缆车车厢里贴着「请勿摇晃」，所有人都在摇
ferry.en: a "do not rock" sign in the car, and everyone rocks it

livehouse.en: the sticky floor goes "smack" with every step

rooftop.zh: 水箱上有人用粉笔写了一首没写完的歌词
rooftop.en: unfinished lyrics chalked on the water tank

nightmarket.zh: 辣椒油在锅里「滋啦」一声，整条街都呛
nightmarket.en: chili oil hits the wok and the whole street coughs

any.zh: 远处有人在练唢呐，总在同一个地方断
any.en: someone far off practising the suona, always breaking at the same spot

any.zh: 手机信号在防空洞里只剩一格
any.en: one bar of signal inside the shelter

text.zh: 舅舅讲冷笑话，没人笑，他自己笑完开始擦杯子。
text.en: My uncle tells a terrible pun, nobody laughs, he laughs alone and starts polishing a glass.

text.zh: 贺一舟非要比 solo，输了说「明年再来」，赢了也说「明年再来」。
text.en: He Yizhou insists on a solo-off; when he loses he says "next year", when he wins he also says "next year".

text.zh: 凌澈的最高评价是「可以」，大家开始争论「可以」和「可以。」哪个更好。
text.en: Ling Che's highest praise is "Workable"; the band starts arguing whether "Workable" or "Workable." is better.

text.zh: 苏婆婆往每个人手里塞冰粉，苏枕默默把自己那碗的花生挑给别人。
text.en: Granny Su presses ice jelly on everyone; Su Zhen silently picks the peanuts out of hers and gives them away.

text.zh: 闻川板着脸递冰水，一人一瓶，递完说「不是给你们的，买多了」。
text.en: Wen Chuan hands out cold water stone-faced, one each, then says "Not for you. Bought too many."

text.zh: 防空洞回声太大，闻笛骂人会被骂两遍，苏枕面无表情地说「混响」。
text.en: The shelter echo is so big Wen Di's every insult lands twice; Su Zhen deadpans: "Reverb."

text.zh: 「闻笛那嗓子，肯定要去选秀的。……我是说，可惜了。」
text.en: "Wen Di's voice, she's bound for a talent show. ...I mean, what a waste."

text.zh: 「我们枕枕晚上睡觉，左边那只耳朵老是捂着。」
text.en: "My Zhen sleeps with her hand over her left ear these days."

text.zh: 「黎雀那个娃，嘴巴凶，心是好的。别的我不晓得。」——说完擦杯子。
text.en: "That Li Que, sharp tongue, good heart. That's all I know." Then he polishes a glass.

text.zh: 「她最近半夜还在唱。破音那句，唱了十几遍。」
text.en: "She's still singing at midnight. That line where she cracks, a dozen times over."

text.zh: 「那个投稿的账号，录音质量是可以的。」
text.en: "Whoever submitted that recording: the audio quality was workable."

text.zh: 「小样是谁传的？反正我们队没人干这种事。……黎雀那天确实不在。」
text.en: "Who leaked the demo? Nobody in my band would. ...Li Que wasn't around that day, though."

habits.en: steps outside whenever her phone rings

contradiction.zh: 最想被人听见，却不让人听出她在哭
contradiction.en: wants most to be heard, won't let anyone hear her cry

growth.zh: 从一个人拍板，到问一句「你们怎么想」
growth.en: from deciding alone to asking "what do you lot think"

style.zh: 写在歌词本背面，像歌词：短句、押一半的韵、划掉重写
style.en: on the back of her lyric book, like lyrics: short lines, half-rhymes, crossings-out

hides.zh: 北京；她怕自己一个人唱不好
hides.en: Beijing; her fear that she can't sing well alone

seesMe.en: the one who dares argue chords with me

seesMe.zh: 最后一句不能让他听见我破音
seesMe.en: he must not hear me crack on the last line
the one who read the paper

dejaVu.zh: 「怪了，这个和弦，你是不是以前就弹给我听过？」
dejaVu.en: "Weird. That chord, haven't you played it for me before?"

awayVoice.zh: 「新歌我改了两个字。……你回来再听。」
awayVoice.en: "I changed two words in the new song. ...Hear it when you're back."

habits.en: drums on the table when something's wrong
always stands to Wen Di's right

contradiction.zh: 节拍最准的人，听不见一半的世界
contradiction.en: the steadiest time-keeper can't hear half the world

growth.zh: 从一个人硬撑，到让人站在左边
growth.en: from coping alone to letting someone stand on her left

style.zh: 没有句子，只有数字和符号：BPM、次数、一个小点代表一件好事
style.en: no sentences, only numbers and marks: BPM, counts, a dot for each good thing

hides.en: how many days the ringing has lasted; that she is scared

habits.en: touches the keys when you hit a nerve
burns her finger without a sound

contradiction.zh: 嘴上最狠，替人做的事最多
contradiction.en: harshest tongue, does the most for others

growth.zh: 从默默背锅，到肯说「不是我」
growth.en: from quietly taking the blame to saying "it wasn't me"

style.zh: 记账本：日期、金额、一行刻薄的批注
style.en: an account book: dates, amounts, one acid remark per line

hides.en: the rent; that she wants to go back

seesMe.zh: 蒋老板家的外甥，A 弦低了
seesMe.en: the owner's nephew, A string flat

seesMe.zh: 唯一问我「不是你吧」的人
seesMe.en: the only one who asked "it wasn't you, right?"
someone I can share a key with

dejaVu.zh: 「你这个问题……我好像回答过。勇敢的问题总是重复。」
dejaVu.en: "That question... I feel like I've answered it. Brave questions repeat."

awayVoice.en: "Your bass is out of tune again. Just a guess."

habits.en: clicks the recorder on and off when nervous

contradiction.zh: 收集全城的声音，自己的话说不出口
contradiction.en: collects a whole city's sounds, can't say her own words

growth.zh: 从躲在匿名账号后面，到当面开口
growth.en: from hiding behind an anonymous account to speaking face to face

style.zh: 声音日记：每天一个拟声词当标题，下面是录了什么、在哪、几点
style.en: a sound diary: each day titled with one sound word, then what was recorded, where, when

hides.zh: 「雾里收音」是她；那段配文不是她写的
hides.en: that she is "Heard in the Fog"; that she didn't write that caption

seesMe.zh: 低音炮（外地口音，样本一号）

seesMe.en: the one who heard the confession

dejaVu.zh: 「咦，你这句『你好』，我好像已经录过了。」
dejaVu.en: "Huh, I think I've already recorded your 'hello'."

awayVoice.en: "Vmmm— (that's the sound of you not being here)"

awayVoice.zh: 「今天的雾是『呼——』的。你听得见吗。」
awayVoice.en: "Today's fog goes 'whooo—'. Can you hear it."

habits.en: polishes glasses when keeping a secret

contradiction.zh: 最反对乐队，记得每一首歌
contradiction.en: most against the band, knows every song

habits.en: laughs when he loses, then practises

habits.zh: 说到外孙女就压低声音
habits.en: lowers her voice about her granddaughter
